units: t/duration/interval: milliseconds. rate: alpha,beta,gamma in degrees/second. acceleration and gravity: x,y,z in metres/second²; gravity includes gravity. orientation/neutral: alpha,beta,gamma in degrees, browser device frame. null means unavailable. Optional calibration: position in black-marker widths at lock; multiply by markerWidthCm for estimated cm. Origin is browser viewport centre, x right, y up, z toward player. Rotation matrices row-major. Camera fieldOfView is assumed on the long image edge, not measured intrinsics; depth and tilt are approximate. Position is NOT updated after lock. Rotation is not a reconstructed hand position. Events describe grip and recognizer decisions; all sensor samples are retained independently.
